svg.aria-label: Agent session lifecycle — Boot, Load Mental Model, Read Context, Do Work, Update Model cycle showing how agent expertise compounds each session
svg.title: The Session Lifecycle — Agent Memory Compounds Every Cycle
svg.desc: A circular lifecycle diagram centered on a Backend Dev agent. Five stages arranged in a clockwise ring (Boot, Load Mental Model, Read Context, Do Work, Update Model) with arc connectors between them. A traveling dot circuits the ring showing how each session compounds the agent's expertise. Animation: 15s cycle — center reveal, clockwise stage-by-stage reveal with arc draws, dot circuit pulse, breathe and reset.

g.text: Boot · Load · Read · Work · Update · Repeat
EVERY SESSION COMPOUNDS THE AGENT'S EXPERTISE
